executionResult.executionNotes: Implemented versioned JSON export/import for form values with full-payload validation before applying imports. Form data autosaves through local persistence, and imported values remain editable and survive PDF serialization. Added MIME-aware save/download handling for JSON in browser, extension, and Electron runtimes while preserving PDF as the default.
